subject: Biology
central_question: How do muscles, bones and joints work together to produce movement and locomotion in the human body?
in_scope_units: Organisation of skeletal muscle fibres and sarcomeres.
banned_topics: Lung anatomy and alveolar gas exchange

known_pitfalls.correction: All locomotion is movement, but many movements do not change the location of the whole organism.

known_pitfalls.claim: The H zone contains actin and myosin.
known_pitfalls.correction: The H zone contains thick filaments not overlapped by thin filaments.

known_pitfalls.claim: The A band shortens during contraction.
known_pitfalls.correction: The A band retains its length while the I band and H zone narrow.

recommended_example_progression: Use NCERT Exercise 7 to classify movement types.

Use NCERT Exercise 4 to correct H-zone and skeletal statements.
Use NCERT Exercise 9 to classify joints.
Use NCERT Exercise 10 to consolidate skeletal and muscle facts.
